coefficient.validation: 382 published 2025 high waters at Arcachon-Eyrac paired with the Brest model: bias +1.75 points, 37 % within +/-1, 57 % within +/-2, max 7 (target +/-1 for 90 %).
coefficient.nodalDrift: M2 nodal factor 0.963 (2025) -> 0.997 (2029); the fit averages 0.985 over 2022-2026, i.e. +/-1.5 % around the fit mean, absorbed by u_h = 0.60 m and the 2-point gate margin.
